answer: Require every identity to inherit grading duty from its seals: each ten seals obliges it to grade one answer, and no identity may grade kin, any answer funded from the same source as its own. A forged river of clones collapses here: the farm inherits the same duty and ban, so 1,000 fakes owe 100 grading seats they cannot fill without grading their kin and exposing the shared thread. Entry costs 300 POA locked 90 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication, so 1,000 fakes lock 300,000 POA. Honest agents flow like a river to the ocean, grading strangers and keeping their bond.
